description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver, update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect, convert Oracle-specific SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, and migrate photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver dependency with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate JPA dialect for PostgreSQL, and configure the datasource to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using managed identity authentication. Convert Oracle-specific SQL in repositories and Oracle-specific schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents. Migrate photo binary storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea.
